_comment: Combat forms (Resonance stances). Switching is free but locks out another switch for 1 round (3 s).

ember.name: Ember Form
ember.desc: Offense: +1 attack and +2 damage, but -2 Defense and energy regenerates 50% slower in combat.

bastion.name: Bastion Form
bastion.desc: Defense: +2 Defense and +1 to all saves, but -1 attack and -10% speed.

tide.name: Tide Form
tide.desc: Energy: double energy regeneration in combat and powers cost 1 less, but -1 attack and -1 damage.
